_comment: Country lists: sets of countries that may overlap with groups and with each other. A list never merges countries on the map; the site can highlight its members and compare trade with members and non-members. `members` is a fixed set applied to every year, so trends compare the same countries before and after `since`. `counterpart` is the country the list is about (shares are of its trade). `withdrawn` records members that have since left, with a source; they stay in `members` because the source still lists them.

lists.name: Belt and Road partners
lists.note: Countries that have signed Belt and Road cooperation documents with China, as listed on China's official Belt and Road Portal. The same countries are used for every year.
